<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ent-decl "<!ENTITY internal 'Expanded Value'>">
  %ent-decl;
  <!ENTITY ext SYSTEM "nonexistent.ent">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY banner SYSTEM "banner.png" NDATA png>
]>
<?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
<root xmlns="http://example.org/ns/base" xmlns:sub="http://example.org/ns/sub">
  <!-- Top level comment exercising parser comment states -->
  <sub:child sub:id="1">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA section containing markup <child>&internal;</child> ]]>
  </sub:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item+)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e-base "BaseEntity">
  <!ENTITY e-derived "&e-base; & More">
  <!ENTITY % param "<!ELEMENT nested (#PCDATA)>">
  %param;
]>
<?xml-target processing-instruction-data="value"?>
<catalog xmlns="http://xml.org/catalog" xmlns:m="http://xml.org/metadata">
  <!-- Comment 1 before item -->
  <item m:role="primary">
    <![CDATA[
      <!DOCTYPE nested>
      <nested>CDATA with nested tags and entity &e-derived;</nested>
    ]]>
  </item>
</catalog>
```

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record)*>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pEnt "<!ENTITY entA 'EntityAValue'>">
  %pEnt;
  <!ENTITY entB "&entA; Extended">
]>
<?xml-stylesheet href="style.css"?>
<archive xmlns="http://schema.org/archive" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/">
  <!-- Archive comment block with entity reference &entB; inside comment? No, entity refs in comments are literal -->
  <record xlink:type="simple" dc:title="TestRecord">
    <![CDATA[
      Raw text data with entity reference inside CDATA: &entB;
    ]]>
  </record>
</archive>
```

<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE document [
  <!ELEMENT document (section)*>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ref1 "Val1">
  <!ENTITY ref2 "&ref1; Val2">
  <!NOTATION txt SYSTEM "text/plain">
  <!ENTITY file SYSTEM "data.txt" NDATA txt>
]>
<?xml-app-info status="active"?>
<document xmlns="http://xml.example.com/doc" xmlns:ns="http://xml.example.com/ns">
  <!-- Comment preceding namespace and entity test -->
  <ns:section id="sec-01">
    <![CDATA[
      <ns:section>Nested CDATA block</ns:section>
    ]]>
    &ref2;
  </ns:section>
</document>
```
